item.title: Introducing CoolSim Next: The Future of Data Center Thermal Modeling
item.description:
Today marks a significant milestone in the evolution of data center thermal modeling. After 17 years of continuous innovation with CoolSim, we’re thrilled to introduce CoolSim Next — a complete ground-up rebuild that reimagines how engineers design and optimize data center cooling systems.

Why CoolSim Next?

The data center industry has evolved dramatically over the past decade. Edge computing, AI workloads, and sustainability requirements have pushed thermal management to new levels of complexity. Meanwhile, the tools we use for thermal modeling have largely remained the same.

item.title: About CoolSim
item.description:
About Applied Math Modeling, Inc.

Applied Math Modeling, Inc. (AMMCO) has been at the forefront of data center thermal modeling for over 17 years. Our flagship product, CoolSim, has helped engineers worldwide design more efficient data center cooling systems.

Our Mission

We believe engineers should own their simulation pipeline.

Too many simulation tools lock you into proprietary formats and black-box solvers. CoolSim Next changes that by building on OpenFOAM, the industry-standard open-source CFD toolkit. You get enterprise-grade capabilities without vendor lock-in.
